audit_metadata.title: Phase 9.1 Classification Label Audit & Feasibility
audit_metadata.audit_objective: Audit candidate lake-condition classification targets (STABLE, EXPANDING, UNUSUAL_CHANGE), evaluate measurement-uncertainty noise floor, investigate label sensitivity, and prevent rule-derived label leakage.

candidate_classes.STABLE: Annual lake area change within defensible measurement noise floor (|delta| <= 1.0 sigma_delta OR |rel| <= 5% OR moderate non-catastrophic shrinkage: -3.0 sigma <= delta < 0 and rel >= -20%).
candidate_classes.EXPANDING: Statistically meaningful expansion exceeding observation uncertainty (delta > 1.0 sigma_delta and rel > 5%) up to exceptional thresholds (<= 3.0 sigma_delta, <= 20% relative expansion).
candidate_classes.UNUSUAL_CHANGE: Independently verified exceptional events: massive rapid growth (>3.0 sigma_delta and >20% relative) or severe sudden drainage/GLOF (<-3.0 sigma_delta and <-20% relative).
candidate_classes.AMBIGUOUS: Observations failing to satisfy physical class conjunctions (e.g. small lakes with high relative change but sub-3-sigma noise). Explicitly tracked (N=897) and excluded from supervised training.

measurement_uncertainty_findings.scientific_interpretation: Over 90% of observed annual changes in the 11,849 matched cohort are smaller than the single-observation edge-pixel delineation uncertainty. Models predicting raw classes without uncertainty awareness will fit to satellite segmentation noise.

operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.rule_based_risk_engine_status: RiskEngine statuses (SAFE/NORMAL, WATCH, ELEVATED/UNUSUAL_CHANGE, STALE, INSUFFICIENT_DATA) are heuristic operational alert tiers combining sensor discordance, staleness, and arbitrary percentage thresholds. They must NEVER be used as ground-truth training labels.
operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.abstention_separation: WATCH and INSUFFICIENT_DATA are operational quality/abstention states, NOT physical lake-change categories.
operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.independent_target_formulation: Supervised labels are constructed strictly from consecutive physical area observations and GLO AREA_UNCERTAINTY, completely independent of the operational rule engine.

asymmetry_and_contraction_handling.physical_reality: Glacial lakes expand gradually over years via calving/ice melt, but can contract gradually via summer evaporation, seasonal freeze-thaw border variations, or drainage. Moderate contraction is NOT an emergency.
asymmetry_and_contraction_handling.label_assignment: Moderate contractions are assigned to STABLE (representing normal seasonal fluctuation), while only catastrophic drainage (<-3.0 sigma AND <-20%) triggers UNUSUAL_CHANGE.

class_imbalance.canonical_reconciliation_note: Previous candidate draft values (90.84% / 4.87% / 4.29%) conflated Category C ambiguous shrinkage (rel < -20%, N=393) with unusual change (115 + 393 = 508) and forced positive ambiguous changes into expanding (577). Canonical reconciliation independently resolves all 11,849 observations into mutually exclusive classes (STABLE=10760, EXPANDING=77, UNUSUAL_CHANGE=115) with 897 explicit ambiguous observations.
class_imbalance.mitigation_plan: Cost-sensitive loss weighting (scale_pos_weight / class_weight), focal loss, and PR-AUC/macro-F1 optimization. Synthetic oversampling (SMOTE) is strictly prohibited on validation/test sets.
